title: 'I had my bra strap pinged by flirty ghost at haunted museum'
excerpt: Video captured the moment Julie Staniland jumped in shock after the incident
content:
A stunned gran claims a 'flirty' ghost pinged her bra strap in a haunted objects museum - in front of her gobsmacked husband. Julie Staniland visited the Haunted Objects Museum in Rotherham in South Yorkshire, with her 56-year-old husband Roger and daughter Amy, 30, on September 26.

The married couple, known as Spookseekers Paranormal while conducting paranormal investigations, were walking around the property with Amy to scope out their surroundings and turn on all the lights. As they entered the 'Demon room' upstairs, Julie claims her bra strap was pulled by a flirtatious spirit.

CCTV footage shows husband Roger saying the name 'Annabelle' while pointing at the Conjuring-inspired rag doll sitting in a glass cupboard. Seconds later, a loud 'twang' can be heard in the clip and the 52-year-old is seen to jump in shock and grab her shoulder as her bra strap is seemingly pulled out of the blue.

In shock, the gran-of-three is seen to look around the room for an explanation but the trio are all left bewildered when no culprit can be found. Julie now believes her underwear was pulled by a 'flirty' spirit who likes to target women.

After telling her colleagues at work about the incident, the GP receptionist says they now all want to go and spend a night at the haunted museum. Julie, from Leeds, West Yorkshire, said: "As we were standing in the room, I could feel something from behind me pull my bra strap and let it go.

"It was so quick and unexpected as we hadn't even started the investigation at this point, it could have been from anything in that room. It was so loud it was such a shock, I found it quite funny and took me by surprise.

"I think it was a spirit in the room giving us a sign. It was so bizarre that it went for my bra strap. I've never had that happen before in all the time I've been doing it. It's obviously a spirit targeting ladies if it did this to my bra strap. It's 100 per cent a spirit that's into women, it seemed like the spirit was being a bit flirty.

"My husband and daughter were so shocked as they heard it snap so clearly. Normally if someone feels something, other people aren't aware until you've told them but it was so loud."

After the spiritual encounter, the mum-of-three reached out to Lee Steer, owner of the museum, and asked him to watch back the CCTV footage of their visit. Lee said the 'Demon room' is full of 'dangerous' spirits and said Annabelle does like to express her presence in 'extreme' ways.

The 33-year-old said she has been known to 'scratch and burn' people in the past who have entered this room and that it's mostly women who are targeted. Lee, from Rotherham in South Yorkshire, said: "In The Haunted Objects Museum we have a room called the 'Demon room'. This is where our most dangerous spirits are kept.

"In this room we have many items and dolls and boxes that are meant to contain demonic entities. However, the main item is Annabelle, a UK replica of the Annabelle doll from the States but this one actually had a documented history of hauntings.

"Many people who have visited that room have left with scratches. In one month, five people have visited our museum and left with scratches or burns. On this occasion, it feels the spirit got a little closer in a different way. It's interesting in the video of the woman (Julie), Annabelle is mentioned and then the bra strap was pulled.

"I'm not sure why Annabelle would do this to her, if it is her, but out of all the spirits in there she does sometimes like to prove to people she's real in the most extreme way. It is mainly females that get targeted in the 'Demon room'."
